# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For this project, the user expects a full structural settings redesign as separate tabs (not a continuous page), including a dedicated keybinds tab with editable bindings.

## UI/UX Preferences
- User prefers high-energy, exaggerated, rewarding, and unique UI animations with strong hover/click feedback.
- Values context-relevant motion cues due to ADHD usability needs.
